title: The Signal's Edge
subtitle: hands open at the crossing
mapEpigraph: The field is already moving toward you.

prompts.text: What has remained after longing, recognition, permission, attunement, story, and vow?
What can be carried without being clutched?
What am I carrying with me as I cross into the work itself?

blocks.title: Speak the answer
blocks.instruction: Speak the answer. Close the encounter. Let the atmosphere cross-fade from Signal into Field; no further task is required.
